title: Rational internal Hom with a fixed integral second argument
statement: For a scheme X, coefficient prime l and finite coefficient extension E, let w be an integral constructible object, and assume that RHom(K,w) is integral constructible for every integral constructible K. Restrict the permitted-pair rational internal Hom of def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom to pairs (K,Qw). This defines localizedDual. Its object at op K is Q of the integral restricted dual of K.obj. It is additive and linear over the localized coefficient ring, and its map on every a tensor f is HEq to a tensor the actual integral restricted-dual map of f.op.

proof.text: Construct the functor into permitted rational pairs by fixing the second object to Qw; preservation supplies the pair predicate. Compose with the actual rational internal Hom.

Specialize its bilinear arrow specification to the identity in the second factor. The resulting linear map proves additivity and homogeneity. The pure-tensor specification, with second scalar one, is the required integral dual map.
